Three steps to install the CLI, pair your host, and enable a background service that survives reboot.
Install the latest ClawConnect CLI on the host computer. This only makes the `clawconnect` command available; it does not register auto-start.
Pair each host profile with Relay. Use OpenClaw for the local OpenClaw gateway, or Hermes Agent for the Hermes runtime.

Run `clawconnect install` after pairing. This starts the agent in the background and registers paired profile services to auto-start after login or reboot. Without this step, reboot will not start ClawConnect automatically.
Return to the chat page — as long as the gateway is online, you can chat. If you have multiple hosts, switch them in Settings > Gateway.

Let OpenClaw send and receive files
After setup, ClawLink can send files from the computer to iPhone with `clawconnect send-file`, and iPhone can send files back through chat attachments.
This depends on `skill-creator` and the `clawconnect-agent` send-file flow. Confirm the tools first, then generate the `file-transfer` skill from the template.
After tapping the button, OpenClaw will inspect `clawconnect send-file`, generate the `file-transfer` skill, verify relay upload, and save the preference.
